00043 inline vFloat VEC_MUL_OP(vFloat const& leftVec, vFloat const& rightVec)
00044 {
00045     vFloat returnVec;
00046     VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM;
00047     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ASM(3);
00048     VFP_FIXED_4_VECTOR_OP3(VFP_OP_MUL, &leftVec, &rightVec, &returnVec);
00049     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO_ASM;
00050     VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM;
00051     return returnVec;
00052 }
00053

00177 
00178 inline void MultAndAdd(DSPSplitComplex& In1, DSPSplitComplex& In2, DSPSplitComplex& Out, const int VecLength4) throw()
00179 {
00180     int VecLength = VecLength4 >> 1U; // we need half the number of iterations for 8!
00181     
00182     float *InReal1 = In1.realp;
00183     float *InImag1 = In1.imagp;
00184     float *InReal2 = In2.realp;
00185     float *InImag2 = In2.imagp;
00186     float *OutReal = Out.realp;
00187     float *OutImag = Out.imagp;
00188     
00189     float Nyquist1, Nyquist2;
00190     Nyquist1 = In1.imagp[0];
00191     Nyquist2 = In2.imagp[0];
00192     
00193     In1.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00194     In2.imagp[0] = 0.f;
00195     
00196     Out.imagp[0] += Nyquist1 * Nyquist2;
00197     
00198     //  OutReal[i] = VFP::add8(OutReal[i], VFP::sub8(VFP::mul8(InReal1[i], InReal2[i]), VFP::mul8(InImag1[i], InImag2[i])));
00199     //  OutImag[i] = VFP::add8(OutImag[i], VFP::add8(VFP::mul8(InReal1[i], InImag2[i]), VFP::mul8(InImag1[i], InReal2[i])));
00200     
00201     VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM;
00202     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ASM(7);
00203     
00204     while(VecLength--) {
00205         asm volatile ("fldmias %0, {s24-s31}                        \n\t"
00206                       "fldmias %4, {s8-s15}                         \n\t"
00207                       "fldmias %5, {s16-s23}                        \n\t"
00208                       "fnmacs s24, s8, s16                          \n\t"
00209                       "fldmias %3, {s8-s15}                         \n\t"
00210                       "fldmias %2, {s16-s23}                        \n\t"
00211                       "fmacs s24, s8, s16                           \n\t"
00212                       "fstmias %0!, {s24-s31}                       \n\t"
00213                       
00214                       "fldmias %1, {s24-s31}                        \n\t"
00215                       "fldmias %4!, {s8-s15}                        \n\t"
00216                       "fldmias %3!, {s16-s23}                       \n\t"
00217                       "fmacs s24, s8, s16                           \n\t"
00218                       "fldmias %5!, {s8-s15}                        \n\t"
00219                       "fldmias %2!, {s16-s23}                       \n\t"
00220                       "fmacs s24, s8, s16                           \n\t"
00221                       "fstmias %1!, {s24-s31}                       \n\t"
00222                       
00223                       : "=r"(OutReal), "=r"(OutImag), "=r"(InReal1), "=r"(InReal2), "=r"(InImag1), "=r"(InImag2)
00224                       :  "0"(OutReal), "1"(OutImag) , "2"(InReal1), "3"(InReal2), "4"(InImag1), "5"(InImag2)
00225                       : "r0", "memory", "cc", VFP_CLOBBER_S8_S31
00226                       );
00227     }
00228     
00229     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO_ASM;
00230     VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM;
00231     
00232     In1.imagp[0] = Nyquist1;
00233     In2.imagp[0] = Nyquist2;
00234 }
